biology: Specimens collected from black locust, white poplar and Chinese willow.
soldier: Soldier head deep yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown with deep brown bases tinged with red, labrum and pronotum yellowish brown, legs pale yellow with the tibiae darker. The setae on the head capsule and pronotum are numerous, the median area of the pronotum with about 30 long hairs. Head capsule rectangular, the fontanelle pore distinct but not projecting. Labrum like a flattened square, the anterior lateral corners of the labral apex rounded and the centre straight. Mandible apices rather curved. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 strongly sclerotised, distinctly thicker than segment 2, about twice as long as segment 2. The flange over the antennal socket strongly sclerotised, not reaching the lateral margins of the head. Compound eyes pale yellow, their distance from the antennal socket roughly equal to the short diameter. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a V-shaped median incision, the lateral margins steeply narrowing backwards, the posterior margin nearly straight and hardly concave at the centre, the midline visible.
